notes.title: Dusty The Lazy Cat Update 1.0.1 Is Out!
notes.content:
[h1]Bugs Fixed[/h1]
[b]• Fixed:[/b] Snowman that sometimes the snowball was overlapping with the snowman and instantly break.
[b]• Fixed:[/b] Glass spheres that wanted stop spinning.

[h1]Added[/h1]
[b]• Added:[/b] Pull input.
[b]• Added:[/b] World-1 Beacons.
[b]• Added:[/b] World-2 Boats, Ships and Mushrooms.
[b]• Added:[/b] World-3 Japanese house, Bell and Small fountain.
[b]• Added:[/b] World-4 Igloos.
[b]• Added:[/b] World-5 Spooky house's and Potions.

[h1]Nerfed[/h1]
[b]• Nerfed:[/b] Made spikes collision smaller.
